package.name: race_auv_apriltag_cuda
package.description: In-process CUDA helpers for the AprilTag pipeline. Two shared libraries: a C shim around NVIDIA's cuAprilTags detector (loaded by ctypes), and a GPU image-stage shim (nvjpeg decode/encode + VPI CUDA fisheye rectify). Used by race_auv_camera_pkg's apriltag_detector_node as the "cuda" detector and image backends.
